description:
Browser-driven web tools — uses headless Chromium via Playwright to
        fetch single-page-app sites that the plain-HTTP mc-agent-tools-web
        can't see (JavaScript-rendered content, cookie/consent banners that
        block static fetches, etc.).

        Kept as a separate module from mc-agent-tools-web because it pulls
        in a ~150MB Chromium download on first use — apps that don't want
        that footprint can leave this off their classpath.
